morbi.headline: Mixed week as falling freight and cheaper fuel balance declining tile export projections.
what_changed: Tile export market projections dropped to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following improved propane supply availability.
Ocean container freight rates for Morbi ceramics dropped by up to 50 percent.
Somany Ceramics announced a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports are projected to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for export shipments [d6c30857de2c]
Improved propane supply allowed Morbi ceramic units to cut higher-cost PNG consumption [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Destination-wise export volumes to assess the actual impact of the Rs 12,000-13,000 crore projection.
Propane vs PNG price differentials and fuel substitution levels across MSME ceramic kilns.
Details on Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking plan, including capex, funding mix, and location impact [0f642d309dd8].

surat.headline: Surat cluster shows diverging trends with recovering diamond orders and easing MMF textile costs.
what_changed: Crude oil prices dropped 17% in 10 days, easing input costs for Surat's textile industry.
Surat diamond units halved their Diwali break due to improved orders and demand recovery.
Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore in investment.
stress_signals: Position Printing Association announced a 15% rate hike and mandated a strict 45-day payment term [id ad48975ddfcf].
SGCCI sought stringent GUJCTOC action against organized gangs causing payment defaults and textile fraud [id 421d4bf835f5].
A Surat diamond merchant committed suicide by jumping into the Tapi River [id 9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Diamond units halved their Diwali holiday break on improved orders, following a four-year slump [id 5fc0b7b85616, id bae3b8d48691].
Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units with Rs 1,521 crore in investment [id 021c037e28d9].
MANTRA expanded into the MedTech sector and was selected for a national textile sustainability project [id 8cfd965ad293, id 5e7cd22236e9].
what_to_watch: Monitor repayment track records and working capital utilization given the strict 45-day payment terms introduced by printing associations [id ad48975ddfcf].
Track debt levels and liquidity in diamond units despite improved post-Diwali order books [id 5fc0b7b85616].
Watch for implementation timelines of the Textile Ministry's capacity database drive [id 5177389da7be].
